column1: # Inline formatting typed as key events, checking after every key that the text never flickers between styled and plain.
# before<TAB>keys<TAB>expected<TAB>look. ‸ caret, «» selection, ↵ newline. Keys: Ⓑ Ⓘ Ⓢ Ⓗ Ⓒ Format ▸ Bold, Italic,
# Strikethrough, Highlight, Inline Code; → ← arrows; ⤓ a click at the end of the note; ✎ ✔ an input method's か marked
# and committed; ⏎ Return; ⌫ Backspace; ↶ Undo; ↷ Redo.
# look: the note's first letter after the last key, B bold, I italic, S struck, H highlighted, C code, · plain.
# A space typed inside a span keeps it styled while the caret is there.
# Typing on past the markers moves the space out of them, so the note keeps valid Markdown.
# One Undo takes back what was typed past the markers, and puts the space back where it was typed.
# Leaving the span another way shows the Markdown as it is.
# Input methods: text being composed is left alone and committed as it was typed, even past the markers.
